response.body:
Here are some tech events happening in Berlin this week:

```embeds_results_view
title: Tech Events in Berlin
embeds: investing-in-civic-6jt, august-meetup-interactive-OVq, business-networking-startups-tEs
```

* **[Investing in civic infrastructure](embed:investing-in-civic-6jt)** — Tuesday, August 4, 16:00 (at Medulla, Dresdener Str. 113B)  
  A public evening discussing civic technology, shared spaces, governance, and how digital infrastructure for cities is sustained.
* **[August Meetup: Interactive Audio](embed:august-meetup-interactive-OVq)** — Tuesday, August 4, 18:00 (at Ableton AG, Schoenhauser Allee 6-7)  
  Monthly Audio Developer Meetup featuring a talk on screen-free interactive audio worlds by Robyn Pacetti (Protagonists!) and a session on detecting AI-generated content in hybrid music mixtures by Fernando Garcia.
* **[Business Networking - Startups, Investors & Tech](embed:business-networking-startups-tEs)** — Tuesday, August 4, 19:00 (at Winterfeldtstraße 21)  
  An international networking format connecting startups, tech professionals, and investors in a relaxed environment.

*(Note: There are also several online sessions this week through Microsoft Reactor and AI application groups if you prefer remote participation.)*

1. Would you like details on any of these specific events?
